skills: Your hands' skills (all they can do, one at a time):

- go_to(target, range, dig): Walk to a place, a player, a mob, the nearest block of a type, or the spot a player is looking at. A player out of sight: first to where she last saw them. "Come here" / "next to me": player:<name> with range 1. "Go there" / "stand here" while they point their view at a spot: looking:<name> with range 0. "Climb the mountain" / "get to the top": peak (the highest ground near, see your state). "Get out" / "go up" underground: surface (the way out to the sky; with dig=yes it digs up when there is none). Stops when: no path, target not found or gone, attacked, time limit.

- mine(block, count, radius): Break blocks of one type nearby and collect what drops. "log" means any kind of log. Stops when: none left within radius, no suitable tool, unreachable, attacked badly, time limit.

- fight(target, radius): Fight hostile mobs: the nearest hostile (creepers first, then skeletons, then zombies), or one type. Stops when: health low (retreats, then eats), outnumbered (flees), none found, time limit.
- explore(goal, radius): Walk to unexplored ground nearby, watching for a goal; reports places noticed on the way (villages, caves, water, lava). Stops when: night, danger nearby, time limit.
- eat(food): Eat the best food she has, or a named food. Stops when: not hungry, nothing to eat.
- sleep(): Sleep in the nearest bed until morning (also sets where she respawns). Stops when: no bed nearby, not night, monsters nearby, bed taken.

- craft(item, count): Craft an item from what she carries, using a crafting table nearby if the recipe needs one. Stops when: no recipe, missing ingredients (says which), needs a crafting table and none is placed nearby.

- follow_player(player, distance, seconds): Stay close to a player for a while. Out of sight: first walks to where she last saw them. Stops when: the player leaves or gets out of sight, attacked, stopped.

- place(block, where): Put down a block she carries (e.g. a crafting table, a torch, a furnace): next to her, or at a spot. A full block (dirt, cobblestone) can also go into water or lava, resting against a solid block beside it. Stops when: she has none, the spot is taken or has nothing to rest on, can't reach it.
- collect_items(item, radius): Pick up items lying on the ground nearby (all, or one kind). Stops when: nothing to pick up, items out of reach, inventory full.
- give(player, item, count): Walk up to a player and toss them some of an item. Stops when: she has none, the player isn't around, can't reach them.
- look_at(target, seconds): Turn to look at a player, a mob, a block or a place for a few seconds. Stops when: the target isn't around or leaves.

- store(item, count): Put items into the nearest chest or barrel: one kind, or "all" (keeps tools, weapons, armour, food, torches). Stops when: no chest within 16 blocks, she has none of it, the chest is full.
- take(item, count): Take items out of the nearest chest or barrel. Stops when: no chest within 16 blocks, the chest has none of it, her inventory is full.

- smelt(item, count): Smelt or cook items in the nearest furnace (raw iron -> iron ingot, raw beef -> steak...), adding fuel she carries. Stops when: no furnace within 16 blocks, she has none of it, no fuel, it can't be smelted.
- wear(item): Put armor on: a named piece, or the best she carries for every slot that has nothing better on already. Stops when: no armor to put on, or nothing better than what she wears.

- surface(): Swim up for air: straight up through open water, or to the nearest air pocket when something is overhead. Her breathing reflex does this by itself whenever her air runs low under water. Stops when: no air within reach, time limit.
